author_claim: Codex Vaticanus B text and order are followed as the foundation of the edition throughout the Prophets
short_quote: The great Vatican MS., whose text and order we have generally followed, ends with the Prophets.
qualification: Vaticanus B chosen as earliest and most valuable single manuscript witness throughout the Prophetic books

author_claim: In the Prophets the critical apparatus employs Codex Marchalianus Q, Codex Cryptoferratensis Γ, and Dublin fragments alongside B, א, and A
short_quote: In the Prophets it has been possible to employ, in addition to the great codices B א A, the Codex Marchalianus (Q)...
qualification: Manuscript collation base expanded significantly in Volume III for the prophetic literature

author_claim: Codex Marchalianus Q is an important 6th-century prophetic uncial containing Hexaplaric signs and readings from Aquila, Symmachus, and Theodotion
short_quote: A heliotype of the MS. was published in 1890... and a monograph upon the Codex by Dr Antonio Ceriani
qualification: Qmg supplies critical Hexaplaric readings as at Isaiah 28:16
